items.titleEn: Bieber's final start before Deadline 'definitely my worst' with Blue Jays
items.summaryEn: Righty records just two outs, sets franchise mark with six walks in tough first inning
bodyEn: WASHINGTON -- Blue Jays right-hander Shane Bieber looked to be finding his rhythm in time to solidify his status as a key asset held by one of the likely sellers at Monday’s Trade Deadline.
Then came Tuesday night’s nightmarish outing in Toronto’s 8-6 loss to Washington at Nationals Park.

Struggling with his grip in a game delayed at the start by 1 hour and 7 minutes due to torrential storms, Bieber walked six batters and retired only two before exiting after only two-thirds of an inning in what could be his final appearance for the club.
The 2020 American League Cy Young Award winner and two-time All-Star threw only 15 of 42 pitches for strikes, while allowing the first four runs to set the Nationals on track to even the series.

“The only thing he really said was it was really hot, he was sweating a lot. Having a tough time gripping the ball,” manager John Schneider said. “The last thing I thought was that, six walks in the first inning from a guy like him.”

By the time Schneider gave Bieber the early hook, he held an infamous new franchise record for most walks issued in an inning. Per Elias Sports Bureau, Bieber was one free pass away from entering truly abnormal territory as the fourth since 1889 to walk seven or more in a single frame. The last time that happened, Senators left-hander Dolly Gray issued eight walks in one inning against the White Sox on Aug. 28, 1909.

“You gotta find a way to get through it, right?” Bieber said. “And I wasn't able to do that tonight, so, ultimately, follow up what was maybe my best start as a Blue Jay with what was definitely my worst. Nobody was more frustrated than me. I let the guys down tonight and so I wear that one wholeheartedly.”
Bieber, who spent most of the first half of the season on the injured list, said the issue wasn’t stuff or anything going on health-wise.
“I got no excuses, man,” he said. “I gotta find a way to get out of that first inning and dry my hands off, and change [my] shirt and eat up innings after that.”
Bieber hurt his own cause when he lost track of the bag covering first base as CJ Abrams hustled out an infield single as one of three batters he faced who did not reach via free pass.
That would’ve led to the second out before Bieber’s last four walks. Instead, his ERA spiked more than a run to 5.74.

Kazuma Okamoto hit his 24th home run in the fifth after entering for the injured Vladimir Guerrero Jr. in the fourth, and George Springer clubbed his 12th, a three-run shot that pulled the Blue Jays within two in the eighth.

But Toronto (49-59) dipped to a season-low-tying 10 games below .500 for a fourth time in the last seven days, sending the probability they’ll be shopping Bieber and others at the 6 p.m. ET Trade Deadline just a little bit higher.
A victory could’ve secured Toronto’s first series win since taking two of three at the Giants on July 6-8, and perhaps prolonged hope of climbing back into playoff contention.

“I would hate to discredit how big of an outing that could have been, [how] big of a game that could have been for us,” Bieber said. “I don't want to say that was just one of those days and I’m past it. I'm definitely frustrated. All I can do is be accountable and move forward, and work toward my next one.”
Bieber was still making a prolonged recovery from 2024 Tommy John surgery when the Blue Jays acquired him in a 2025 Deadline deal.

And after Bieber took a tough Game 7 loss to the Dodgers in the 2025 World Series, allowing Will Smith’s 11th-inning solo homer, Bieber surprised most onlookers by picking up his ‘26 player option for $16 million only days after the painful defeat.

By late March, Bieber was placed on the 15-day IL with right elbow inflammation, and when he was finally cleared to pitch again, he made five rehab starts to come close to simulating a Spring Training buildup.

That did not lead to immediate success upon his Major League return, but Bieber showed signs of his earlier Guardians days in his previous two outings, allowing only six hits and two walks across those successive quality starts.
items.titleZh: 比伯在交易截止日前的最后一场先发‘绝对是我最差的一次’
items.summaryZh: 右投手仅制造两个出局数，首局创下队史六次保送纪录
bodyZh: 华盛顿讯——蓝鸟右投手Shane Bieber本有望找回节奏，巩固其作为交易截止日（周一）潜在卖家所持关键资产的地位。
然而周二晚在国民公园球场，多伦多8-6负于华盛顿的比赛却成了噩梦。
由于暴雨导致比赛推迟1小时7分钟开始，Bieber在控球上挣扎，他保送了六名打者，仅制造两个出局数，在投了仅仅2/3局后退场，这可能是他代表球队的最后一场比赛。
这位2020年美国联盟赛扬奖得主、两届全明星球员，42球中仅有15球是好球，同时让前四分得分，使国民队追平系列赛。
“他唯一说的就是天气太热，他流了很多汗。控球很困难。”主教练John Schneider说，“我完全没想到，像他这样的投手会在第一局保送六次。”
当Schneider早早将Bieber换下时，他创造了一项不光彩的队史纪录——单局最多保送次数。据Elias体育局统计，Bieber距离进入真正异常领域仅一步之遥：自1889年以来，单局保送七次或以上的投手只有四位。上一次发生这种情况是1909年8月28日，参议员队左投Dolly Gray在对阵白袜的一局中保送了八名打者。
“你得想办法挺过去，对吧？”Bieber说，“但今晚我没能做到，所以，最终，继可能是我作为蓝鸟球员最好的先发之后，迎来了绝对是最差的一次。没有人比我更沮丧。我今晚让队友们失望了，所以我完全承担这个责任。”
Bieber本赛季上半场大部分时间都在伤病名单上，他表示问题不在于状态或健康方面。
“我没有借口，兄弟，”他说，“我得想办法摆脱第一局，把手擦干，换件衬衫，然后继续吃局数。”
当CJ Abrams奋力跑出一个内野安打时，Bieber忘记踩一垒垒包，这加重了他的困境。Abrams是他面对的三名未通过保送上垒的打者之一。
这本该在Bieber最后四次保送之前制造第二个出局数。相反，他的自责分率飙升超过一分至5.74。
冈本和真在第五局击出第24支本垒打——他在第四局替换受伤的Vladimir Guerrero Jr.上场——George Springer则敲出第12支，一记三分炮在第八局将分差缩小到两分。
但多伦多（49胜59负）在过去七天内第四次跌至低于五成胜率10场，追平赛季最低，这使他们将在美国东部时间下午6点的交易截止日兜售Bieber和其他球员的可能性略增。
一场胜利本可为多伦多确保自7月6日至8日对阵巨人拿下两胜以来的首个系列赛胜利，或许还能延续重返季后赛竞争的希望。
“我不想贬低这次出局的重要性，这对我们来说可能是一场重大的比赛，”Bieber说，“我不想说这只是普通的一天，我已经翻篇了。我绝对很沮丧。我能做的就是承担责任，向前看，为下一次做好准备。”
Bieber仍在从2024年的Tommy John手术中恢复，蓝鸟在2025年交易截止日的一笔交易中得到了他。
在2025年世界大赛中，Bieber在第七场苦战负于道奇，被Will Smith在第十一局击出再见阳春炮。仅几天后，Bieber出人意料地执行了2026年价值1600万美元的球员选项。
3月底，Bieber因右肘发炎被放入15日伤病名单。当他最终获准再次投球时，他进行了五次复健先发，以模拟春训的调整。
这并未立即在大联盟回归中取得成功，但Bieber在前两次出赛中展现了早期守护者时期的风采，连续优质先发中仅被击出六支安打、保送两人。

items.titleEn: Vladdy likely to sit Wednesday due to right hamstring tightness
bodyEn: WASHINGTON -- Vladimir Guerrero Jr. exited in the middle of the fourth inning of the Blue Jays’ game at the Nationals on Tuesday night with right hamstring tightness after running out an infield single in the top of the third.
Kazuma Okamoto entered at first base and then homered in the top of the fifth to close Toronto’s deficit to 7-3.

In his second at-bat of a game delayed more than an hour by torrential storms passing through the region before first pitch, Guerrero pulled Cade Cavalli’s first-pitch offering down the third-base line and raced to the bag to beat the errant throw of the charging Jorbit Vivas.
As Vivas’ throw bounded away from Luis García Jr., Guerrero turned and hustled toward second as the Jays’ first run of the game scored, but showed slight signs of discomfort.
Guerrero has played in 103 of Toronto’s 108 games this season, but has lacked the power stroke fans have come to expect of the six-time All-Star.

He’s slashing .265/.345/.357 with six home runs. The slugging percentage is nearly 100 points off his previous low for a single season, and his homer total is three below the nine he hit during the pandemic-shorted 2020 campaign.

items.summaryZh: 小格雷罗因右腿筋紧张提前退场，可能缺席周三比赛。
bodyZh: 华盛顿——小弗拉迪米尔·格雷罗在周二晚上蓝鸟对阵国民的比赛中，于第三局上半击出内野安打后因右腿筋紧张，在第四局中途退场。
冈本和马进入一垒防守，并在第五局上半击出本垒打，将蓝鸟的落后分差缩小至7-3。
在比赛因暴雨延迟一个多小时后，格雷罗的第二次打席中，他将Cade Cavalli的第一球拉向三垒线，并快速冲上一垒，避开了Jorbit Vivas的传球失误。
当Vivas的传球从Luis García Jr.身边弹开时，格雷罗转身冲向二垒，为蓝鸟拿下本场比赛的第一分，但显示出轻微的不适迹象。
格雷罗本赛季在蓝鸟的108场比赛中出战了103场，但缺乏球迷对这位六届全明星球员所期待的长打火力。
他的打击三围为.265/.345/.357，有6支本垒打。长打率比其单赛季最低纪录低了近100点，本垒打总数比因疫情缩短的2020赛季的9支还少3支。

items.titleEn: Varland brothers reunite for exchange of lineup cards
bodyEn: WASHINGTON – The Nationals and Blue Jays game was a family affair for the Varland brothers.
Gus and Louis Varland participated in a memorable lineup card exchange prior to Tuesday’s game at Nationals Park.
Louis pitched a scoreless inning for Toronto in the series opener on Monday. The following afternoon, Gus was called up from Triple-A Rochester to rejoin Washington’s bullpen.
The siblings from Minnesota reunited at home plate for the pregame ceremony.
Louis, 28, earned his first All-Star selection this season with a 1.02 ERA and 22 saves. Gus, 29, made the Nationals' Opening Day roster and has earned six saves.
This is another notable day at the park for the duo. Back in 2022, the brothers faced off as starters in the Minor Leagues in a Double-A game between the Tulsa Drillers and Wichita Wind Surge.

bodyZh: 华盛顿——国民与蓝鸟的比赛对瓦兰德兄弟来说是一场家庭聚会。

对于这对兄弟来说，这是又一个值得纪念的球馆日子。2022年，他们曾在双A的塔尔萨钻机工与威奇塔风涌之间作为先发投手对决。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays top pick Carlon has lofty goals and serious stuff
bodyEn: TORONTO -- These days, Blue Jays fans are left looking to the future, whether they want to or not.

There’s a lot to like, though, in a farm system that’s grown stronger at the top and done a much better job of developing pitchers in recent years. Cole Carlon, the Blue Jays’ top pick in the 2026 MLB Draft (No. 39 overall), represents that next wave of talent.
Fresh off their success developing Trey Yesavage, Carlon will join a system that also boasts Nolan Perry (No. 3), Johnny King (No. 4), Gage Stanifer (No. 7) and Ricky Tiedemann (No. 10).
After Carlon met with the media for the first time Tuesday since signing his deal with the Blue Jays, this is what you need to know:
Carlon’s path to Toronto:

Carlon and Blue Jays area scout Adam Arnold, who’s based in Arizona, built a good relationship throughout the scouting process. Carlon also had a great resource at Arizona State in his pitching coach, Jeremy Accardo, who pitched five seasons for the Blue Jays from 2006-10.

“I’m relentless,” Carlon said. “I’m going to go out there, compete, get to two strikes as soon as I can and try to get as many outs as possible, any way I can. I really just love going out there to compete and going right after guys with my stuff.”

Carlon singled out Tigers ace Tarik Skubal as a pitcher he models his game after, both big lefties. Skubal threw bullpens at ASU during the offseason, too, so Carlon was able to watch one of the best pitchers on the planet work and pick his brain about what goes into a successful big league career.

After shifting from ASU’s bullpen to the rotation in his junior year, Carlon’s Draft stock skyrocketed and he was projected by many public rankings to be picked higher than No. 39. Scott Boras, who represents Carlon, continued to praise the Blue Jays’ organization, calling this pick “a feather in Toronto's cap."

“Normally in the Draft, when you have Cole’s abilities, they’re going at much higher levels,” Boras said. “The benefit here is that his late development was not as widely known as you’d expect. What you saw his junior year was, frankly, something where I think that few in this Draft had those abilities.”
The upside:
A fastball that lives in the upper 90s with one of the best sliders in the Draft -- a true wipeout pitch -- is a fine place to start.

“One of my friends texted me after, and I was laughing about the way he put it. He said that ‘He’s got two October pitches,’” said director of amateur scouting Marc Tramuta. “I felt like that was a good characterization of the fastball and slider that are currently in place. We just like the big physicality at 6-foot-5. We think there’s some athleticism to his delivery.”

Like Boras said, Carlon’s development came late in the process. He is, by Draft standards and especially at his age (21), a “fresh arm.” He also stands 6-foot-5, 230 pounds. There’s nothing but upside here.

Building out the rest of Carlon’s arsenal will be the key to succeeding in the big leagues, but with his fastball and slider alone, Carlon should carve through the lower levels of the Minor Leagues when he gets his start in pro ball.
Next steps for Carlon:

It’s easy to dream of another quick mover after Yesavage shot from Single-A to the World Series in 2025, touching every level of the Blue Jays’ system in the process. That’s going to grab the attention of the next guy that comes along, too.

“My goal is to be a big leaguer as soon as possible,” Carlon said. “I’m happy they have the ability to put a guy like me, who just got drafted, in the position to become a big leaguer next year. That was definitely awesome to see. That’s my goal, to be pitching in the big leagues as soon as I can. I’ve still got to run my own race, and I’ll get there when I get there.”

Coming off 83 2/3 innings last season at ASU, which was already a spike in workload as he moved from the bullpen, don’t expect to see Carlon pitching much this season, if at all. He could very well start the 2027 season on Yesavage’s path, though, making only brief stops in Single-A Dunedin and High-A Vancouver as the Blue Jays get him on their program. It’s a program that, all of the sudden, is producing some great results with pitchers just like Carlon.

items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟2026年首轮秀Cole Carlon立志尽快升上大联盟，其高速球和滑球被视为顶级武器。
bodyZh: 多伦多 -- 如今，蓝鸟球迷不论愿不愿意，只能展望未来。
不过，有太多值得期待的地方：农场系统顶端变得更加雄厚，近年来在培养投手方面也做得更好。2026年MLB选秀蓝鸟首轮第39顺位选中的Cole Carlon，正是下一波天赋的代表。
在成功培养Trey Yesavage之后，Carlon将加入一个还拥有Nolan Perry（第3）、Johnny King（第4）、Gage Stanifer（第7）和Ricky Tiedemann（第10）的系统。
周二，Carlon与蓝鸟签约后首次接受媒体采访，以下是您需要了解的信息：
Carlon通往多伦多的道路：
Carlon与蓝鸟球队球探Adam Arnold（驻亚利桑那）在球探过程中建立了良好关系。Carlon在亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）的投手教练Jeremy Accardo也为他提供了巨大帮助，Accardo在2006-10赛季为蓝鸟投了五个赛季。
“我永不言弃，”Carlon说，“我会走上投手丘，竞争，尽快拿到两好球，然后想尽办法尽可能多地制造出局。我真的很喜欢上场竞争，用我的武器直接攻击打者。”
Carlon特别提到老虎王牌Tarik Skubal是他模仿的对象，两人都是高大的左投手。Skubal休赛期也在ASU投过牛棚，因此Carlon得以观察这位地球上最好的投手之一是如何训练的，并向他请教成功的大联盟生涯需要什么。
在三年级从ASU的牛棚转入轮值后，Carlon的选秀行情飙升，许多公开排名预计他会在第39顺位之前被选中。代表Carlon的Scott Boras继续称赞蓝鸟组织，称这一选秀是“蓝鸟帽子上的一根羽毛”。
“通常在选秀中，像Cole这样的能力会去更高的顺位，”Boras说，“好处是，他的晚熟没有像预期那样广为人知。他三年级展现的能力，坦率地说，我认为本届选秀中很少有人具备。”
优势：
一颗常驻90英里以上的快速球，以及本届选秀中最好的滑球之一——真正的终结球——是一个很好的起点。
“我的一位朋友后来发信息给我，他说的方式让我发笑。他说‘他有两个十月球’，我觉得这是对现有快速球和滑球的恰当描述，”业余球探总监Marc Tramuta说，“我们喜欢他6英尺5英寸的身材。我们认为他的投球动作有些运动能力。”
如Boras所说，Carlon的成长过程较晚。按选秀标准，尤其是他21岁的年龄，他属于“新鲜手臂”。他身高6英尺5英寸，体重230磅。只有上升空间。
构建Carlon其余球路将是在大联盟取得成功的关键，但仅凭他的快速球和滑球，Carlon在职业棒球起步时应该就能轻松横扫小联盟低级别联赛。
Carlon的下一步：
在Yesavage从1A直接升到2025年世界大赛、一路经历蓝鸟系统每个级别之后，很容易梦想另一个快速晋升者。这也会吸引下一位来者的注意。
“我的目标是尽快成为大联盟球员，”Carlon说，“我很高兴他们能让像我这样刚被选中的球员有机会在明年成为大联盟球员。这绝对令人惊叹。这就是我的目标，尽快在大联盟投球。但我仍然要跑自己的比赛，我会在合适的时候到达那里。”
上赛季在ASU投了83又2/3局，这已经是从牛棚转过来的工作量激增，预计本赛季Carlon不会投太多，如果投的话。不过，他很可能在2027赛季沿着Yesavage的道路起步，只在1A Dunedin和高级1A Vancouver短暂停留，蓝鸟将把他纳入自己的培养计划。这个计划突然之间在培养像Carlon这样的投手方面产生了出色的成果。

items.titleEn: Scherzer grinds through birthday return to Nationals Park
bodyEn: WASHINGTON -- Max Scherzer’s second return from an IL stint this season went better than his first, enough so that he’s hopeful for what could still be ahead.

Scherzer labored through 2 2/3 innings on 75 pitches on his 42nd birthday, but he escaped by allowing only one run in his former home park in the Blue Jays’ 3-2 win over the Nationals in Monday night’s series opener.

“I knew it was going to be a little rusty,” Scherzer said after his 100th career start at Nationals Park. “I knew this happens when you come off the IL, and you haven't pitched as much. Every time out, it should be a little bit better, a little bit better, a little bit better execution.
“If I can get that going, I know I can still compete at this level at the highest level and compete against anybody. So it should be fun for me in the second half here.”

In the three-time Cy Young Award winner’s first outing since June 10, he struck out four to move within eight of Walter Johnson (3,515) for 10th all-time on MLB’s all-time strikeout list (according to the Elias Sports Bureau, the official statistician of Major League Baseball). Scherzer also walked three and allowed four hits.

In the process, he lowered his ERA by about three-quarters of a run, to 9.49, in his seventh start this season and first since he landed back on the IL with a combination of back spasms and right thumb inflammation. He has retired more than 10 batters in only two of those outings, both of those coming before his first injury setback due to right forearm tightness and left ankle inflammation.
Most encouraging for Blue Jays manager John Schneider was an absence of strong contact, aside from Luis García Jr.’s second-inning RBI double.

“I thought he battled really well, you know what I mean?” Schneider said. “They were fouling off some stuff, and the walks were kind of uncharacteristic of him. But really only one hard-hit ball from García, and he gave us everything he had.”
In Scherzer’s previous return from the IL on June 10, he allowed five runs in 3 1/3 innings before landing back on the IL.

Barring any other setbacks, Scherzer might have one more outing before the Aug. 3 Trade Deadline to convince possible trade suitors he’s worth a low-risk flyer (should he waive the no-trade clause in his one-year, $3 million deal).

“I can't 100% say, the way this has gone for me, but I am in a good spot,” he said of another potential start on Sunday. “I do think I'll recover out well from this one and hopefully continue to march back up and get built back up as a starter here.”
Asked what could still be accomplished this season for the last-place Blue Jays (49-58), Scherzer alluded to ignoring the chatter that Toronto could be Deadline sellers.

“Look, our record is our record,” he said. “It’s frustrating as heck that we’re in this position, but we’re professionals. We have a job to do. … You’ve got to go out there and do everything you can to win, every single day. That’s the mentality we have in the clubhouse, and we kind of let the other stuff just be noise.”

Luis Urías homered, Ernie Clement hit an RBI double and Myles Straw singled in a run for Toronto. Mason Fluharty and Spencer Miles each worked 1 1/3 scoreless innings of relief, Tyler Rogers and Jeff Hoffman pitched one scoreless frame each and Louis Varland stranded a pair of runners in the ninth for his 22nd save.
Scherzer received a standing ovation of roughly 30 seconds when he first took the mound at Nationals Park, the venue he called home from 2015-21.

He worked out of a bases-loaded jam in the first, striking out Dylan Crews before inducing Daylen Lile into a groundout. After Scherzer allowed García’s RBI double, he stranded two more Nationals by fielding José Tena’s chopper himself.
He departed with one aboard in the third to another appreciative applause from the crowd as he walked off after a 12-pitch strikeout of Lile and a brief mound visit with Schneider.

“I got out there, and I just wanted to check on him, and he said, ‘Your call,’” Schneider said. “And I said, ‘That was a lot. That was a lot right there.’ And he's like, ‘Yeah.’ He's like, ‘Your call.’ And I said, ‘OK, nice job.’”
items.titleZh: 谢泽尔生日重返国民球场 2.2局失1分
items.summaryZh: 谢泽尔42岁生日重返国民球场，先发2.2局仅失1分，蓝鸟3-2取胜。
bodyZh: 华盛顿——马克斯·谢泽尔本赛季第二次从伤病名单回归的表现比第一次更好，足以让他对未来仍抱有希望。
谢泽尔在42岁生日当天用75球苦撑2.2局，但在蓝鸟周一晚间系列赛首战3-2战胜国民的比赛中，他在老东家主场只失1分，成功摆脱困境。
“我知道会有些生疏，”谢泽尔在职业生涯第100次于国民球场先发后说道。“我知道当你从伤病名单回归、投球不多时就会这样。每次出赛，执行都会好一点、好一点、再好一点。”
“如果我能保持下去，我知道自己仍然可以在最高水平上竞争，与任何人对抗。所以下半赛季对我来说应该会很有趣。”
这位三届赛扬奖得主自6月10日以来的首次出赛中，他投出4次三振，距离沃尔特·约翰逊（3,515次）仅差8次，升至MLB历史三振榜第10位（根据MLB官方统计机构埃利亚斯体育局统计）。谢泽尔还投出3次保送，被击出4支安打。
在此过程中，他将自己的自责分率降低了约0.75，降至9.49，这是他本赛季第七次先发，也是他因背部痉挛和右手拇指发炎再次进入伤病名单后的首次先发。在这七次出赛中，他只有两次解决了超过10名打者，而且这两次都发生在他因右前臂紧绷和左脚踝发炎首次受伤之前。
对蓝鸟总教练John Schneider来说，最令人鼓舞的是除了Luis García Jr.在第二局打出的打点二垒安打外，没有强劲的击球。
“我认为他战斗得很努力，你明白我的意思吗？”Schneider说。“他们打出了一些界外球，保送有点不像他。但实际上只有García打出一颗硬击球，他付出了自己的一切。”
在谢泽尔6月10日此前一次从伤病名单回归时，他在3.1局中失5分，随后再次进入伤病名单。
除非出现其他挫折，谢泽尔可能在8月3日交易截止日前还有一次出赛，以向可能的交易追求者证明他值得低风险押注（如果他放弃一年300万美元合同中的不可交易条款）。
“我不能100%确定，考虑到我目前的情况，但我处于一个良好的位置，”他在谈到周日可能再次先发时说道。“我确实认为我会从这次出赛中恢复得很好，并希望继续回升，在这里重新建立起先发投手的状态。”
当被问及对于垫底的蓝鸟（49胜58负）本赛季还能取得什么成就时，谢泽尔暗示忽略关于蓝鸟可能在交易截止日前成为卖家的传闻。
“听着，我们的战绩就是我们的战绩，”他说。“我们处于这个位置令人沮丧，但我们是职业球员。我们有工作要做……你必须每天上场尽一切努力去赢。这就是我们更衣室的心态，我们让其他事情成为噪音。”
Luis Urías击出本垒打，Ernie Clement敲出打点二垒安打，Myles Straw击出一分打点一垒安打，为多伦多贡献得分。Mason Fluharty和Spencer Miles各后援1.1局无失分，Tyler Rogers和Jeff Hoffman各投一局无失分，Louis Varland在第九局留下两名跑者，拿下第22次救援成功。
当谢泽尔第一次登上国民球场投手丘时，他获得了大约30秒的起立鼓掌，这座球场是他2015年至2021年期间的主场。
他在第一局化解了满垒危机，先三振Dylan Crews，再让Daylen Lile击出滚地球出局。在谢泽尔被García击出打点二垒安打后，他亲自处理了José Tena的滚地球，再留下两名国民打者。
第三局他在一出局一垒有人时退场，在用一个12球三振Lile并与Schneider进行简短投手丘会面后，他走下投手丘，再次获得观众感激的掌声。
“我走到那里，只是想看看他，他说‘你决定’，”Schneider说。“我说‘那是很多球了。那里已经很多了。’他回答说‘嗯。’他说‘你决定。’我说‘好的，干得好。’”

items.titleEn: Barger's outlook brightens as García hits another hurdle
bodyEn: WASHINGTON -- The Blue Jays had mixed news on the injury front on Monday.
Right fielder Addison Barger avoided a full Tommy John procedure on his ailing right elbow and could be ready to go for Spring Training, manager John Schneider said.
However, right-hander Yimi García is shut down indefinitely in the rehab progression from his 2025 right elbow surgery.

Additionally, the Blue Jays placed Braydon Fisher on the bereavement list Monday to make room for Max Scherzer, with the right-hander returning from the IL to pitch at his former home on his 42nd birthday. And outfielder Jesús Sánchez (right ankle) could rejoin Toronto as early as Friday.

Barger had what Schneider called a “repair” procedure on his right elbow by Dr. Keith Meister on Monday, rather than the full Tommy John reconstruction previously on the table. The recovery time is expected to be six months, meaning the 26-year-old should be healthy in time for 2027 Spring Training.
Barger slashed .243/.301/.454 with 21 homers in 135 games in 2025, his second MLB season, but he has played only nine times for Toronto in 2026.
García pitched one rehab inning with Single-A Dunedin on Saturday in his latest attempt to get back to full health after previous rehab assignments were halted.

“Kind of had more symptoms, kind of neck nerve, after throwing, so we're going to shut him down,” Schneider said. “He's going to go see another specialist, I think, for their possible thoracic outlet [syndrome].”

Schneider said it wasn’t clear yet whether this latest halt could be season-ending for the 35-year-old reliever who will be a free agent in 2027. Signed to a two-year, $ 15-million contract in December 2024, García made 22 relief appearances before undergoing elbow surgery in September 2025.

Sánchez was slashing .274/.316/.437 with seven homers before he sustained an ankle sprain in early June. He traveled Monday to continue his rehab assignment with Triple-A Buffalo on Tuesday, and Schneider said he could rejoin the Blue Jays for this weekend’s home set against the Cardinals.
items.titleZh: Barger 伤病前景乐观，García 再遇挫折
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟队伤情喜忧参半：Barger 肘部手术成功，有望参加春训；García 康复暂停。
bodyZh: 华盛顿——蓝鸟队周一在伤病方面喜忧参半。
总教练 John Schneider 表示，右外野手 Addison Barger 的右肘接受了非完全尺骨附属韧带重建手术，有望参加春训。
然而，右投手 Yimi García 在 2025 年右肘手术后的康复训练被无限期暂停。
此外，蓝鸟队周一将 Braydon Fisher 列入丧假名单，为 Max Scherzer 腾出位置，后者从伤病名单回归，在 42 岁生日当天于前主场先发。外野手 Jesús Sánchez（右脚踝）最早可在周五重返多伦多。
Barger 周一接受了 Keith Meister 医生实施的“修复”手术，而非此前考虑的完全尺骨附属韧带重建。预计康复期为六个月，意味着这位 26 岁的球员将在 2027 年春训时恢复健康。
Barger 在 2025 年（他的第二个 MLB 赛季）的 135 场比赛中击出 .243/.301/.454 的打击三围，外加 21 支本垒打，但 2026 年仅为多伦多出战 9 场。
García 周六为单 A 达尼丁队投了一局康复比赛，这是他此前康复任务中断后再次尝试恢复健康。
Schneider 说：“投球后出现了更多症状，像是颈部神经问题，所以我们将他暂停。他可能会去看另一位专家，检查是否有 thoracic outlet 综合征的可能。”
Schneider 表示尚不清楚这次暂停是否意味着这位 35 岁、2027 年将成为自由球员的后援投手赛季报销。García 在 2024 年 12 月签下两年 1500 万美元合同，2025 年 9 月接受肘部手术前曾出场 22 次后援。
Sánchez 在 6 月初脚踝扭伤前打击三围为 .274/.316/.437，另有 7 支本垒打。他周一随队前往三 A 水牛城，周二继续康复比赛，Schneider 表示他可能在本周末主场对阵红雀的系列赛中回归。

items.titleEn: 3 key questions for Blue Jays at Trade Deadline
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson’s Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
BOSTON -- Parts of this Trade Deadline could be simple for the Blue Jays. Barring a winning streak that takes them right up to Aug. 3, they’ll be the classic definition of a seller.

This means veterans on expiring contracts, like Kevin Gausman, George Springer and Shane Bieber, are easy trade candidates. Perhaps even Max Scherzer gets a shot somewhere else, especially if he can put up a solid big league outing coming off five no-hit innings in his last Triple-A rehab appearance.

Other parts of this could be more complex. Toronto will receive interest in players with club control remaining beyond 2026 -- someone like Jeff Hoffman -- and this front office could also look to “buy” long-term pieces to fill this rotation and outfield in ‘27 and ‘28.
Beyond the obvious, these are some of the more complicated questions the Blue Jays will be facing:
1. What role will money play at the Trade Deadline?
This is the big one.

The Blue Jays could have the opportunity to flex their financial muscle in a way few other organizations can, which could turn some low-end trades into something bigger. Keep in mind that, with just under one-third of the season remaining, all players traded will still have just under one-third of their 2026 salary remaining.

This is most important when it comes to Gausman and Springer. When the deadline hits at 6 p.m. ET on Aug. 3, the round numbers to remember are that Gausman will have close to $7 million left on his deal and Springer will have just over $7 million. To a lesser extent, this will be a factor if Daulton Varsho or Bieber are dealt, too.

If a contender is taking on Gausman or Springer along with their remaining salary, the prospect return for the Blue Jays will look underwhelming at first glance. Toronto can include cash considerations, though, eating any amount of salary to improve the return package.

In the simplest terms, contending teams will be telling the Blue Jays: If we take on the full salary, we’ll give you a lower-ranker prospect. If you eat a few million bucks, we’ll give you a much better one.

This will be more pronounced, too, if Toronto is dealing with a smaller-market team more conscious of payroll. Teams like the Dodgers, Yankees, Phillies and Braves are better positioned to eat salary and keep their own prospects, but if the Blue Jays are in talks with a low-payroll club, that could be a major opportunity to use their biggest strength -- money -- to win the Deadline.
2. Is Varsho a qualifying offer candidate?

Thirteen players were tendered a qualifying offer last offseason, a one-year, $22.025 million deal which only four accepted: the Brewers’ Brandon Woodruff, the Cubs’ Shota Imanaga, the Tigers’ Gleyber Torres and the Yankees’ Trent Grisham.
When players decline that offer and sign elsewhere (like Dylan Cease did), their original team receives a compensatory Draft pick.

Varsho came into the season with the potential to become one of the top position players on this offseason’s free-agent market, but that hasn’t happened. Instead, the 30-year-old looks more like a candidate for a short-term deal to reset his value, which brings the qualifying offer into play. Even if that number is slightly above $22.025 million this winter, would the Blue Jays consider it? That would essentially put him on Andrés Giménez’s salary, another glove-first player who Toronto is trying to get more offensive value from.
If that’s being considered, there’s an argument to hold Varsho. If not, he’s a clear trade candidate.
3. Would they consider picking up Straw’s 2027 option?

Myles Straw has an $8 million team option for ‘27 with a $1.75 million buyout. While he’s beloved in the clubhouse, a great defender and valuable on the bases, his .576 OPS makes it a tough call for what is essentially a $6.25 million decision.
Option 1: The Blue Jays, facing uncertainty in center in ‘27, hold Straw as a potential fourth or fifth outfielder, leaving them a decision on his team option down the road.

Option 2: If Toronto is already leaning “no” on that option, then Straw could become another trade candidate. Remember, last postseason, Straw appeared in 15 games, but he only started one of them. There would be a team out there in need of that same, late-game option on the bases and in the outfield.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟交易截止日面临三大关键问题
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟可能出售到期合同老将，薪资、Varsho和Straw的动向成焦点。
bodyZh: 本文摘自Keegan Matheson的蓝鸟队内通讯。阅读全文请点击此处，并订阅以定期接收。
波士顿——交易截止日的部分决策对蓝鸟而言可能很简单。除非他们在8月3日前打出一波连胜，否则他们将成为经典的卖家。
这意味着到期合同的老将，如Kevin Gausman、George Springer和Shane Bieber，都是容易交易的候选人。甚至Max Scherzer也可能在别处获得机会，尤其如果他在上次三A康复出场投出五局无安打后，能在大联盟有稳定表现。
其他部分可能更复杂。多伦多将收到对2026年后仍有球队控制的球员的兴趣——比如Jeff Hoffman——而管理层也可能考虑‘买入’长期资产，以填补2027和2028年的轮值和外野。
除了显而易见的因素，以下是蓝鸟将面临的一些更复杂的问题：
1. 薪资在交易截止日扮演什么角色？
这是个大问题。
蓝鸟有机会以其他球队少有的方式动用财务力量，这可能将一些低端交易转化为更大的操作。请记住，赛季还剩不到三分之一，所有被交易的球员仍将剩余不到三分之一的2026年薪资。
这在Gausman和Springer身上最为重要。当截止日于美国东部时间8月3日下午6点到来时，要记住的大致数字是：Gausman合同还剩约700万美元，Springer还剩略高于700万美元。如果Daulton Varsho或Bieber被交易，这也将是一个因素，但程度较小。
如果竞争者接手Gausman或Springer并承担剩余薪资，蓝鸟获得的潜力新秀回报乍看之下会显得平淡。不过多伦多可以加入现金补偿，吃掉部分薪资以提升回报方案。
简单来说，竞争球队会告诉蓝鸟：如果我们承担全额薪资，我们会给你一个排名较低的潜力新秀。如果你吃掉几百万，我们会给你一个更好的。
如果多伦多与对薪资更敏感的小市场球队交易，这一点会更加突出。像道奇、洋基、费城人和勇士这样的球队更能承担薪资并保留自己的潜力新秀，但如果蓝鸟与低薪资球队谈判，那可能是利用他们最大优势——金钱——来赢下截止日的重要机会。
2. Varsho是否是合格报价候选人？
上个休赛期，13名球员获得了合格报价，一份一年2202.5万美元的合同，只有四人接受：酿酒人的Brandon Woodruff、小熊的Shota Imanaga、老虎的Gleyber Torres和洋基的Trent Grisham。
当球员拒绝该报价并签约其他球队（如Dylan Cease），原球队会获得一个补偿选秀权。
Varsho本赛季初有潜力成为休赛期自由球员市场上的顶级位置球员之一，但这并未实现。相反，这位30岁的球员看起来更像是一个短期合同重估价值的候选人，这使得合格报价变得相关。即使这个数字今年冬天略高于2202.5万美元，蓝鸟会考虑吗？这基本上会让他拿到Andrés Giménez的薪资，后者是另一个手套优先的球员，多伦多正试图从他那得到更多进攻价值。
如果考虑这一点，就有理由留住Varsho。如果不考虑，他就是一个明确的交易候选人。
3. 他们会考虑执行Straw的2027年球队选项吗？
Myles Straw有2027年800万美元的球队选项，买断费为175万美元。虽然他深受更衣室喜爱，防守出色且跑垒有价值，但0.576的OPS使得这个本质上625万美元的决定很难做。
选项1：蓝鸟面临2027年中外野不确定性，保留Straw作为潜在的第四或第五外野手，将球队选项的决定留到以后。
选项2：如果多伦多已经倾向于放弃该选项，那么Straw可能成为另一个交易候选人。请记住，上个季后赛，Straw出场15次，但只先发了一场。会有球队需要他这种在比赛后期在垒上和防守端的类似选项。

items.titleEn: With Deadline looming, Gausman improving but doesn't want to go anywhere
bodyEn: BOSTON -- We’ve reached that uncomfortable spot on the calendar when the Trade Deadline casts a shadow on every game.

The Blue Jays lost to the Red Sox on Sunday, 6-1, to drop two of three at Fenway Park, but the story of the day is how each of these individual performances could impact the Deadline, particularly from the Blue Jays’ veterans on expiring deals.
This is what mattered most:
1. Man in the spotlight: Kevin Gausman
Was that it?

Gausman’s next start would line up for Saturday, Aug. 1, at home in Toronto. If the Blue Jays are still positioned as clear sellers at that point, it’s possible that the Blue Jays could choose to hold Gausman back if trade talks are ongoing ahead of the Aug. 3 Deadline. There’s still some uncertainty baked into this, but that’s the spot Gausman and the Blue Jays are in now.

This still hasn’t been a strong stretch for Gausman, but Sunday’s performance was a step up from his last start against the Rays, at the very least. Gausman allowed three runs on five hits through six innings, striking out six batters while walking one.
As it stands today, Gausman has made 147 starts for the Blue Jays, which ranks him ninth in franchise history. Gausman’s 846 1/3 innings rank 11th.
2. The July of George
This looks more like the George Springer who led the Blue Jays to the top of the American League East a season ago, and eventually, the World Series.

Springer now has multiple hits in five of his last seven games, his energy suddenly evident in this lineup. The early half of Springer’s 2026 season was dragged down by a fractured toe, and while it’s difficult to measure how much the postseason run was still wearing on the 36-year-old physically, it couldn’t have helped. The version of Springer we’re seeing right now, though, is full of life and driving the ball consistently.

There’s a risk of this being too little, too late, but even if this still leads to a trade for the Blue Jays ahead of the Aug. 3 Deadline, it can only be good news. A few weeks ago, it looked like Springer’s experience and postseason pedigree would be his main selling points to contenders. If you can throw a hot streak on top of that at the right time, those conversations get much more interesting.

The Blue Jays’ players keep insisting that anything can happen, too. If they want to pull off a miracle run and win 15 in a row like the Red Sox just did, then Springer will need to be leading that run, too.
3. Big picture: The Wild Card mess

The Guardians, now holding the final Wild Card spot, lost Sunday to the Rays, but still hold a 5 1/2-game lead over the Blue Jays. In between, you’ll still find the Twins, Astros, Mariners, Orioles and Tigers, so this isn’t getting any less complicated.

The best way to look at this is still: How many games back of the final spot would the Blue Jays need to be in order to avoid selling on Aug. 3? Three games feels so close, but even then, you’re one of six or seven teams vying for one spot.

Keep an eye on those teams in the race, too, if any of them begin to signal that they’re beginning to buy or sell. This Trade Deadline feels like a logjam waiting on these teams, but it can’t last forever, and perhaps this weekend’s trade between the Red Sox and Nationals with Connelly Early for Curtis Mead will get things rolling.
items.titleZh: 交易截止日临近，高斯曼状态回升但无意离开
items.summaryZh: 交易截止日临近，蓝鸟老将高斯曼状态回升，但表示不愿离队。
bodyZh: 波士顿——我们已经到了日历上那个令人不安的时刻，交易截止日给每场比赛都投下了阴影。
蓝鸟周日以1比6输给红袜，在芬威球场三场系列赛中输掉两场，但当天的故事在于每个人的表现如何影响交易截止日，尤其是蓝鸟那些合同即将到期的老将。
以下是最重要的几点：
1. 焦点人物：Kevin Gausman
就这样吗？
Gausman的下一次先发预计在8月1日周六，于多伦多主场。如果届时蓝鸟明确作为卖家，那么在8月3日交易截止日前，如果交易谈判正在进行，蓝鸟可能会选择扣住Gausman。这仍存在不确定性，但这就是Gausman和蓝鸟目前的处境。
对Gausman来说，这仍然算不上表现强劲的时期，但至少周日的表现比他上次对阵光芒时有所进步。Gausman在六局中失三分，被击出五支安打，三振六人，保送一人。
截至目前，Gausman已为蓝鸟先发147场，排名队史第九。他的846又1/3局投球排名第11位。
2. George的七月
这看起来更像是那个带领蓝鸟上赛季登顶美联东区、并最终赢得世界大赛的George Springer。
Springer在过去七场比赛中五场有多个安打，他的活力突然在这条打线中显现出来。Springer的2026赛季上半段因脚趾骨折而受到影响，虽然很难衡量上赛季的季后赛征程对这位36岁老将的身体有多大消耗，但肯定没有帮助。不过，我们现在看到的Springer充满活力，持续击出强劲的球。
这可能有太少、太晚的风险，但即使这仍然导致蓝鸟在8月3日交易截止日前将其交易，这也只会是好消息。几周前，看起来Springer的经验和季后赛血统是他对竞争球队的主要卖点。如果你能在正确的时机再加上一波火热的势头，那些对话就会变得有趣得多。
蓝鸟球员们一直坚持认为一切皆有可能。如果他们想要实现奇迹般的连胜，像红袜刚刚那样连赢15场，那么Springer也需要领跑这场连胜。
3. 大局观：外卡乱局
守护者目前占据最后一个外卡席位，周日输给了光芒，但领先蓝鸟仍有5.5场。在这之间，还有双城、太空人、水手、金莺和老虎，因此情况并未变得简单。
看待这个问题的最佳方式仍然是：蓝鸟需要落后最后一名多少场才能避免在8月3日成为卖家？三场感觉很近，但即便如此，你仍是六七支争夺一个席位的球队之一。
也要关注那些竞争球队，如果其中任何一支开始表明他们开始买入或卖出。这个交易截止日让人觉得是一大堆球队在等待，但不可能永远持续下去，也许本周末红袜和国民之间用Connelly Early换来Curtis Mead的交易将开启局面。

items.titleEn: Tiedemann resumes rehab, touches 97.7 mph in scoreless inning at Single-A
bodyEn: BOSTON -- This has been a long time coming for Ricky Tiedemann, the Blue Jays’ No. 10 prospect who we’ve barely heard from in nearly two years.

It had been 706 days between Tiedemann’s last Minor League appearance in 2024 and his first rehab appearance this season, back on June 16. One outing later, though, Tiedemann had some neck discomfort and received injections, leading to another month on the shelf.

Now, finally, Now, finally, Tiedemann is resuming his rehab with the Tommy John surgery behind him. In what the Blue Jays hope will be the final "start" of a rehab assignment for the gifted 23-year-old, he made an appearance Sunday with the Single-A Dunedin Blue Jays.
This is what you need to know:
How did he perform?
Tiedemann allowed one hit and struck out two over a scoreless inning on 18 pitches. He looked sharp, too, averaging 96.4 mph with his fastball with a peak of 97.7 mph.

Results don’t matter much at this point for the lefty, but still, you can call this one a success. His best pitch of the afternoon came on a 97 mph fastball, up and in on a left-handed batter for strike three.
What’s next?

Tiedemann’s early outings will be planned out, likely including several days in between. Step one comes tomorrow, when Tiedemann begins to recover from this one. From there, he needs to get back into the groove of throwing, recovering and repeating that process over and over.

Eventually, the Blue Jays would like to jump Tiedemann from Dunedin back up to Triple-A Buffalo. He is expected to remain in this bullpen role for now, pitching in shorter stints. Given Tiedemann’s injury history, that seems to be the likelier role for him long-term, at least until he can reestablish himself.
What are they saying?
Back in Spring Training, Tiedemann sounded like a young pitcher with a new lease on life. He looked more like a pitcher, too, after spending a couple of years looking like an NFL linebacker.
Tiedemann is still built big and strong, but he’s learned over the years that pitching isn’t just a strength game. He’s developed in this sense, both physically and mentally.

“You see a lot of guys who are wiry and lanky, or they’re big guys, but you’ll never see a guy who is shredded out there year-round,” Tiedemann said back in February. “It’s not what a pitcher does to stay out there. Finding that out and finding the right weight where I feel easy, efficient and athletic -- and just staying healthy -- that’s the biggest thing. I did gain weight before I got hurt and I felt really strong, but I wasn’t as quick or as efficient or as smooth as I should have. Now, I [am].”
What else?
Tiedemann is on the Blue Jays’ 40-man roster, added last November to protect him ahead of the Rule 5 Draft. This is important, even with August and September in mind.
If the Blue Jays sell at the Trade Deadline and are no longer competitive in September, that opens the door to anyone and everyone on the 40-man.

A lot needs to go right between now and late September for Tiedemann. Given that he’ll be built up carefully, let’s call the “rehab” portion of this at least another month, taking us into late August or even early September. Tiedemann also needs to be pitching and recovering well from each outing ideally with shorter gaps in between. If all of that goes right, the odds are higher than 0%, at least, that we see a glimpse of Tiedemann in late 2026.

If nothing else, though, Tiedemann setting himself up for a “normal” offseason would be a great step. He hasn’t had one of those in a few years, and would once again be one of the most interesting arms in camp next spring.
items.titleZh: Tiedemann恢复复健，在1A无失分局中投出97.7英里快球
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟潜力新秀Tiedemann在1A复健赛中投出97.7英里，表现犀利。
bodyZh: BOSTON -- 对于Ricky Tiedemann来说，这一刻已经等了很久。他是蓝鸟队排名第10的潜力新秀，近两年来我们几乎没听到他的消息。
从Tiedemann在2024年的最后一次小联盟出场，到本赛季6月16日的首次复健出场，中间隔了706天。然而，仅一次出场后，Tiedemann就感到颈部不适并接受了注射，导致他又休战了一个月。
现在，终于，Tiedemann在完成Tommy John手术后重新开始复健。蓝鸟队希望这位23岁的天才球员能完成复健任务的最后一次“先发”，他于周日代表1A的Dunedin蓝鸟队出场。
以下是需要了解的信息：
他表现如何？
Tiedemann用18球投完一局无失分，被打1支安打，送出2次三振。他看起来状态很好，快速球平均时速96.4英里，最高达到97.7英里。
对于这位左投手来说，现在的结果并不重要，但这次出场仍可称为成功。他当天下午的最佳一球是一记97英里的快速球，投向左打者的内角高位，三振出局。
接下来是什么？
Tiedemann早期的出场会有计划安排，可能间隔几天。第一步是明天，Tiedemann将开始从这一场中恢复。然后他需要重新找回投球、恢复并反复重复这个过程的感觉。
最终，蓝鸟队希望将Tiedemann从Dunedin直接提升到3A的Buffalo。他预计暂时会继续担任牛棚投手，进行短局数出场。考虑到Tiedemann的伤病史，这似乎更可能是他长期的角色，至少在他重新证明自己之前。
他们怎么说？
在春训时，Tiedemann听起来像是一位重获新生的年轻投手。在经历了几年看起来像NFL线卫的身材后，他现在看起来也更像投手了。
Tiedemann依然高大强壮，但多年来他学到，投球不仅仅是力量游戏。他在身体和心理上都已有所成长。
“你会看到很多瘦长型的球员，或者大个子，但你永远不会看到一年到头都是肌肉线条分明的球员，”Tiedemann在二月份说道。“这不是投手保持状态的做法。找到合适的体重，让我感到轻松、高效和灵活——并且保持健康——这才是最重要的。我在受伤前增重了，感觉非常强壮，但我不够快速、高效或流畅。现在，我是了。”
还有呢？
Tiedemann在蓝鸟队的40人名单上，去年11月加入以保护他免受规则5选秀的损失。考虑到8月和9月，这一点很重要。
如果蓝鸟队在交易截止日出售，并且在9月不再有竞争力，那么40人名单上的任何球员都有机会。
从现在到9月底，Tiedemann需要很多事情顺利进行。鉴于他会谨慎地逐步提升，复健部分至少还需要一个月，也就是到8月底或9月初。Tiedemann还需要每场投球后恢复良好，并且最好间隔时间更短。如果一切顺利，我们在2026年底看到Tiedemann亮相的概率至少大于0%。
不过，至少让Tiedemann拥有一个“正常”的休赛期将是一大步。他已经好几年没有这样的休赛期了，明年春天他有望再次成为训练营中最令人感兴趣的投手之一。

items.titleEn: Sánchez (right ankle) joins Single-A Dunedin for rehab assignment
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Jesús Sánchez is back in game action down in Single-A Dunedin, putting him on track to potentially return to the Blue Jays by next weekend.

After going 1-for-3 in a Florida Complex League game on Thursday, this was Sánchez’s first game back with a full-season affiliate as he rehabs his right ankle sprain. Nearly a month ago, in late June, Sánchez jammed his foot awkwardly on the bottom of the outfield wall while he was backpedalling for a catch.
Here’s everything you need to know about Sánchez’s rehab.
How did he perform?
Sánchez played five innings in left field in the first half of Dunedin’s Saturday doubleheader and went 0-for-2 with a walk and a run scored.

Also appearing in that game was veteran reliever Yimi García, who has been stuck in a long rehab process this season with multiple pauses along the way. García threw a scoreless inning with one strikeout, but his fastball averaged just 92.9 mph, below where it’s been in the big leagues (96 mph). He’ll continue to build back up in hopes of returning this season.
What’s next?

Sánchez could see a bit more action in Dunedin, given that he can continue to work on his rehab at the Blue Jays’ player development complex across town. Once he’s ready, though, Sánchez will likely shoot right up to Triple-A Buffalo for his final tune-up before returning to the Blue Jays.
What are they saying?
When Sánchez returns, there’s no sense easing him back in or limiting his reps. The Blue Jays want that bat right back in the lineup.
“We want him to play,” manager John Schneider said pre-game Saturday. “Hopefully, he’ll generate some offense and get a chance to play pretty consistently.”
What else?

Sánchez has one year of arbitration remaining after this season, so while he’s not the most obvious trade candidate by any means, everything has to be on the table ahead of the Deadline for the Blue Jays. Sánchez is making $6.8 million this season and is due for one last raise heading into ‘27.

Acquired this spring for Joey Loperfido, Sánchez represented a swing on upside and power by the Blue Jays. At times, it’s worked, but Sánchez’s seven home runs and .753 OPS over 73 games haven’t done much to change the trajectory of the Blue Jays’ lineup. Sánchez’s bat has also been dragged down by his defense, with a team-worst Fielding Run Value of -7.

Trades could clear the way for Sánchez to play nearly every night down the stretch, though, and that could be useful for a Blue Jays organization which needs to assess its outfield heading into 2027. The front office is facing trade decisions on Daulton Varsho and George Springer, and if Myles Straw sticks around, he has an $8 million team option ($1.75 million buyout) for them to consider.

If Sánchez can return and play out the final 50-plus games, that should help to inform the Blue Jays’ offseason. It’s already clear they’ll need a center fielder -- ideally a long-term option like Varsho represented these past few years -- but that need could spill into the corner spots, too.
items.titleZh: Sánchez（右脚踝）前往1A邓尼丁进行康复
items.summaryZh: Sánchez在1A邓尼丁开始康复，有望下周回归蓝鸟。
bodyZh: 波士顿——Jesús Sánchez在1A邓尼丁重返赛场，这使他有可能在下周末前回归蓝鸟。
在周四的佛罗里达综合联赛中3打数1安打后，这是Sánchez在康复右脚踝扭伤期间首次随完整赛季附属球队出赛。大约一个月前，即在6月下旬，Sánchez在后退接球时右脚尴尬地卡在了外野墙底部。
以下是你需要了解的关于Sánchez康复的一切。
他表现如何？
Sánchez在周六邓尼丁双赛第一场中担任左外野手打了五局，2打数0安打，有一次保送并得到一分。
同样出现在那场比赛中的还有老将后援投手Yimi García，他本赛季一直陷入漫长的康复过程，途中多次暂停。García投了一局无失分并有一次三振，但他的速球平均仅92.9英里/小时，低于他在大联盟的水平（96英里/小时）。他将继续恢复状态，希望本赛季能回归。
下一步是什么？
Sánchez可能会在邓尼丁多打一些比赛，因为他可以在镇对面的蓝鸟球员发展中心继续康复训练。不过，一旦他准备好了，Sánchez很可能会直接升到3A水牛城进行最后的调整，然后回归蓝鸟。
他们怎么说？
当Sánchez回归时，没有必要让他慢慢适应或限制他的出场次数。蓝鸟希望他的球棒立刻回到阵容中。
"我们希望他上场，"总教练John Schneider在周六赛前表示。"希望他能贡献一些进攻，并有机会稳定出场。"
还有什么？
Sánchez在本赛季结束后还有一年薪资仲裁资格，因此虽然他在任何情况下都不是最明显的交易候选，但在交易截止日前蓝鸟必须把所有选项都摆上桌面。Sánchez本赛季年薪680万美元，在即将进入27赛季前将迎来最后一次加薪。
Sánchez是今年春天用Joey Loperfido交易来的，代表着蓝鸟对潜力和力量的一次尝试。有时确实奏效，但Sánchez在73场比赛中打出7支本垒打和.753的OPS，并未改变蓝鸟打线的轨迹。Sánchez的球棒还被他的防守拖累，他的防守跑垒价值为-7，位列全队最差。
不过，交易可能会为Sánchez在赛季末段几乎每晚都出场铺平道路，这对于需要在进入2027赛季前评估外场阵容的蓝鸟管理层来说可能很有用。管理层面临关于Daulton Varsho和George Springer的交易决策，而如果Myles Straw留队，他有一份800万美元的球队选项（买断费175万美元）供他们考虑。
如果Sánchez能够回归并打完最后50多场比赛，这将有助于蓝鸟的休赛期决策。已经明确的是，他们需要一名中外野手——理想情况下是像过去几年Varsho那样的长期选项——但这种需求也可能延伸到角落外野位置。

items.titleEn: Cease strengthens his Cy Young case with one-hit shutout of Red Sox
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Dylan Cease, standing on the mound with his hands reaching for the sky after throwing 120 pitches, didn’t look like a man on a 48-57 team. That’s why this matters.

Cease’s talent is only matched by his stubbornness on these special days, creating an unstoppable force. In Saturday’s 6-0 win over the Red Sox, he threw the Blue Jays’ first complete game one-hitter in 16 years, another night flirting with history after he took a no-hitter into the ninth inning earlier this month.
This matters to Cease, a pitcher who openly chases greatness.

Manager John Schneider would have had to drag Cease off that mound in the ninth. On the second-last batter of the game, an animated Cease called his own challenge, then pumped his fist when it was overturned for strike three. He was ready to challenge the final pitch of the game, too, which was called for his 12th strikeout. For two hours and twenty-five minutes, he owned Fenway Park.

"You don’t see this very often,” Schneider said. “Dylan is kind of a throwback pitcher. He’s durable and he thrives on that stuff. You don’t see this much. The no-hitter attempt in San Francisco, you just don’t see this much. Dylan is evolving as a pitcher. I wanted to give him every chance to finish it.”
By the numbers:
This was Cease’s third career complete game. He threw another one-hitter in 2022 and his no-hitter against the Nationals on July 25, 2024.
The first one-hitter by a Blue Jays pitcher since Shaun Marcum on August 16, 2010. Eight days prior to that, Brandon Morrow had done the same while striking out 17.
Only 10 pitchers in franchise history have thrown a complete-game shutout with one or zero hits allowed (a combined 15 times).
His 120 pitches are a career high, the most in MLB this season and the most a pitcher has thrown since Justin Verlander threw 121 on Aug. 31, 2025.
Cease is the first pitcher to throw at least 118 pitches in two outings in the same season since teammate Shane Bieber, who did it in 2021 with the Guardians.
Let’s throw a fun fact on the pile, too. Schneider was Shaun Marcum’s roommate in High-A Dunedin and Triple-A Syracuse back in his playing days. It’s been a while.

Whether a team loses it was for a week, a season or a decade, there need to be reasons to watch. The late 1990s and early 2000s were bleak times for the Blue Jays, but Carlos Delgado was in the lineup every night, and every fifth day, Roy Halladay took the hill. The ‘26 Blue Jays aren’t about to tailspin into another ice age in Toronto, but still, this feels like a lost season in need of some memorable moments.

Even if the season-long results aren’t there, fans just want to see their own passion reflected back. That’s why it’s so important to see Cease doing this exactly how he did it, asking for more and proving that he could do it. It’s another sign of the incredible trust he’s earned from Schneider and pitching coach Pete Walker, too, who just keep letting the big dog eat.

“That means a lot to me,” Cease said. “I went in after the seventh and I was like, ‘Can I get 110 today?’ Just to see if I could get a complete game. They let me go 10 over. There were a lot of foul balls in that last inning, but it was awesome. I’m very happy they let me go for that."

A few pitches into this game, you would have never seen it coming. Frankly, it looked likelier that Cease would last just a few innings. He sat near 93 mph in the first inning, a worrying number from a pitcher who typically lights up the radar gun and can touch 100 mph. Oddly enough, though, this forced Cease to “pitch”, as Schneider put it, and find some weak contact to keep him above water.

“My body was cranky early, so I was just working with what I had and making sure I threw strikes,” Cease said. “When we got to the fifth and I’ve got a no-hitter going, my body was loosening up a little bit. By the end, I had the kill in sight. I was just going for it.”
The race is officially on, too, between Cease and Cam Schlittler for the AL Cy Young Award, and games like these just keep reminding people why Cease has a shot.
items.titleZh: Cease 完封红袜仅被击出一安打，巩固塞扬竞争力
items.summaryZh: Cease 投出蓝鸟16年来首次一安打完封胜，巩固塞扬奖竞争力。
bodyZh: 波士顿——Dylan Cease 在投完120球后站在投手丘上，双手伸向天空，他看起来不像是一支48胜57负球队的球员。这正是这场比赛的意义所在。
Cease 的天赋只有在这些特殊的日子里才能与他的固执相匹敌，形成一股不可阻挡的力量。在周六6比0战胜红袜的比赛中，他投出了蓝鸟16年来的首次一安打完封，这也是继本月初他投出无安打比赛进入第九局后，又一次与历史擦肩而过的夜晚。
这对 Cease 来说很重要，他是一位公开追求伟大的投手。
总教练 John Schneider 在第九局不得不用拖的把 Cease 拉下投手丘。在比赛的倒数第二名打者中，情绪激动的 Cease 自己喊出了挑战，并在改判为第三好球后握拳庆祝。他也准备挑战比赛的最后一球，那球被判为他的第12次三振。在两个半小时的时间里，他主宰了芬威球场。
“你很少看到这样的情况，”Schneider 说。“Dylan 是一位复古型投手。他非常耐用，并且在这种情境下表现出色。你很少看到这样的表现。在旧金山的无安打尝试，你真的很少见到。Dylan 正在作为投手不断进化。我想给他每一个完成比赛的机会。”
数据层面：
这是 Cease 职业生涯第三次完投。他在2022年另有一次一安打完封，以及2024年7月25日对阵国民的无安打比赛。
自2010年8月16日 Shaun Marcum 以来，首次由蓝鸟投手投出的一安打完封。在此之前的八天，Brandon Morrow 也曾做到过，同时投出17次三振。
队史上只有10名投手曾投出过一安打或无安打的完封胜（合计15次）。
他的120球创下了生涯新高，是本赛季大联盟最高，也是自2025年8月31日 Justin Verlander 投出121球以来投手投出的最多球数。
Cease 是继队友 Shane Bieber（2021年在守护者队）之后，首位在同一赛季中两次出赛至少投出118球的投手。
再补充一个有趣的事实：Schneider 在球员时期曾与 Shaun Marcum 在高级1A达尼丁和3A雪城是室友。这已经是挺久以前的事了。
无论一支球队输球是一周、一个赛季还是十年，都需要有观看的理由。上世纪90年代末和21世纪初对蓝鸟来说是黯淡的时期，但 Carlos Delgado 每晚都在阵容中，每五天 Roy Halladay 就会登上投手丘。2026年的蓝鸟不太可能跌入另一个冰河期，但尽管如此，这感觉像是一个需要一些难忘时刻的失落赛季。
即使整个赛季的结果并不理想，球迷们只想看到自己的热情得到回应。这就是为什么看到 Cease 以他这种方式做到这一切如此重要——他主动要求更多，并证明自己能够做到。这也是他赢得 Schneider 和投手教练 Pete Walker 无比信任的另一个迹象，他们只是让这头猛兽继续发挥。
“这对我意义重大，”Cease 说。“第七局之后我进去说，‘我今天能投110球吗？’只是想看看我能不能完成完投。他们让我多投了10球。最后一局有很多界外球，但太棒了。我非常高兴他们让我去争取。”
比赛刚开始的几球，你绝对想不到会这样。坦率地说，看起来 Cease 更可能只投几局。第一局他的球速大约在93英里，对于一个通常能飙到100英里的投手来说，这是一个令人担忧的数字。但奇怪的是，这迫使 Cease 进行“投球”（如 Schneider 所说），并找到一些软弱的接触来让他保持在水面之上。
“我的身体一开始很僵硬，所以我只是利用现有的条件，确保投出好球，”Cease 说。“当我们打到第五局，我还在投无安打比赛时，我的身体稍微放松了一些。到最后，我看到了胜利的曙光。我只是全力以赴。”
竞争也正式开始了，Cease 和 Cam Schlittler 之间的美联赛扬奖争夺，这样的比赛只是不断提醒人们为什么 Cease 有机会。

items.titleEn: Cease (12 K's) shuts out Red Sox as Springer, Vladdy provide the offense
bodyEn: BOSTON -- The Blue Jays still have some flashes in them, especially when Dylan Cease pitches like that.
Saturday’s 6-0 win over the Red Sox was clean and simple, which we haven’t seen enough of from this 2026 team. The win moves the Blue Jays to 48-57.
This is what mattered most:
1. Dylan Cease one-hits the Red Sox

For a moment, it felt like Cease was going to take another run at Dave Stieb, like he did just before the All-Star break in San Francisco. Stieb still lives on as the only no-hitter in franchise history, but Cease was spectacular in Saturday’s win. This was the Blue Jays’ first complete game of the season as Cease allowed just one hit, a double to Andruw Monasterio in the sixth.
It’s the Blue Jays’ first complete game one-hitter since Shaun Marcum on August 16, 2010. Just eight days prior to that, Brandon Morrow did the same in his incredible 17-strikeout game.

Early on, his velocity was downright worrying. His fastball sat below 94 mph in the first inning, alarming from a pitcher who sits 97-98 mph and can touch 100 mph. It slowly crept up as the game went on, though, similar to what we’ve seen over the years from Kevin Gausman. To Cease’s credit, he also controlled this game extremely well, getting the Red Sox hitters to swing through some of his softer stuff while he settled in.
This still looks like Cease versus Cam Schlittler of the Yankees for the AL Cy Young Award. Cease now owns a 2.46 ERA with 167 strikeouts over 113 1/3 innings.
2) Stock up: George Springer

Springer’s three-run home run in the third inning snuck over the Green Monster in left and continued a stretch where he’s looked more like his 2025 self recently. Sure, the Blue Jays wish it had been this way all along, but better now than never.

Springer is one of the most interesting trade options on this roster, and will appeal to different clubs in very different ways. While some contenders simply would not have a spot for Springer, who is limited to the DH spot with the odd day in the corner outfield, other contenders in need of a veteran DH or bench bat could easily see the upside here. Springer is a former World Series MVP with the Astros, and last October, delivered one of the biggest moments in Blue Jays history with his Game 7 ALCS home run against the Mariners.

There’s a certain level of “feel” to Springer’s value, beyond the 2026 numbers. Consider the Red Sox to be one of the contenders who could make sense for Springer, but if he looks good in the coming days, that list may grow.

Money will be a factor, too. Springer is earning just over $24 million this year, the final year of his six-year, $150 million deal. This could be a scenario where the Blue Jays can eat some of that salary in return for a greater prospect return.
3) The right direction for Vladdy
Vladimir Guerrero Jr. reached base four times, including a line-drive single to left field to bring home the Blue Jays’ first run of the game.
Before the game, Guerrero met with the media to address the Blue Jays’ disappointing season, asking the fans for patience and preaching that anything can happen over their final 57 games.

“Before even thinking about [media] or the Trade Deadline, myself and the entire team have to play better,” Guerrero said through interpreter Hector Lebron. “Every time I leave the field, going back to the hotel, that’s all I’m thinking of, seeing how we can get better.”

Guerrero’s season won’t truly turn around until some of these start going over the wall, as he’s stuck at just six home runs this season. There’s no arguing with a day like this, though, and as manager John Schneider said before the game, it’s important for Guerrero to “show the way” to his teammates as they go through a down year.
items.titleZh: Cease（12K）完封红袜，Springer和Vladdy贡献火力
items.summaryZh: Dylan Cease仅被敲1安，蓝鸟6-0完封红袜，Springer轰出三分炮。
bodyZh: 波士顿——蓝鸟队仍有一些闪光点，尤其是当Dylan Cease投出这样的表现时。
周六以6-0战胜红袜的比赛干净利落，这支2026年的球队之前这样的表现并不多见。这场胜利让蓝鸟战绩来到48胜57负。
以下是比赛要点：
1. Dylan Cease只让红袜敲出一支安打。
一度看起来Cease要再次挑战Dave Stieb的纪录，就像全明星周末前在旧金山那样。Stieb仍然是队史唯一无安打比赛的保持者，但Cease在周六的胜利中表现出色。这是蓝鸟本赛季第一场完投，Cease只被击出1支安打——第六局Andruw Monasterio的二垒打。
这是自2010年8月16日Shaun Marcum之后，蓝鸟首次完成完投一安打比赛。在那之前8天，Brandon Morrow在惊人的17次三振比赛中也做到过。
比赛初期，他的球速令人担忧。第一局他的速球低于94英里/小时，对于一个通常投97-98英里/小时、可触及100英里/小时的投手来说，这令人警惕。但随着比赛进行，球速慢慢回升，类似于我们这些年看到的Kevin Gausman。值得称赞的是，Cease很好地控制了比赛，让红袜打者在他调整期间挥空了他的一些偏软球路。
Cease和洋基的Cam Schlittler仍然是美国联盟赛扬奖的竞争者。Cease现在自责分率2.46，在113.1局中投出167次三振。
2) 增值：George Springer
Springer在第三局的三分本垒打刚好越过左外野的绿色怪物，延续了他近期看起来更像2025年状态的表现。当然，蓝鸟希望他一直如此，但迟到总比没有好。
Springer是这支球队中最有趣的交易选项之一，会以不同方式吸引不同球队。虽然一些竞争者可能没有Springer的位置——他只能打指定打击，偶尔守角位外野——但其他需要资深指定打击或替补打者的竞争者很容易看到他的价值。Springer是前世界大赛MVP（随太空人获得），去年十月，他在美联冠军赛第七场对阵水手时轰出蓝鸟队史最重要的一支本垒打。
Springer的价值除了2026年的数据外，还有一定的“感觉”。考虑红袜作为可能适合Springer的竞争者之一，但如果他在接下来几天表现不错，这个名单可能会扩大。
金钱也是一个因素。Springer今年年薪超过2400万美元，这是他6年1.5亿美元合同的最后一年。可能会出现蓝鸟承担部分薪资以换取更高回报的潜力新秀的情况。
3) Vladdy走在正确方向
Vladimir Guerrero Jr.四次上垒，包括一支左外场平飞一垒安打，为蓝鸟送回比赛第一分。
赛前，Guerrero与媒体会面，谈到蓝鸟令人失望的赛季，请求球迷耐心，并强调在剩余57场比赛中任何事情都可能发生。
“在考虑（媒体）或交易截止日之前，我和整支球队必须打得更好，”Guerrero通过翻译Hector Lebron说道，“每次离开球场回酒店，我都在想我们如何才能变得更好。”
Guerrero的赛季不会真正好转，除非这些安打开始飞过墙外——他本赛季只有6支本垒打。但这样的一天无可争议，正如总教练John Schneider赛前所说，Guerrero在球队经历低迷年份时向队友“展示方向”很重要。
items.author: Keegan Matheson

items.titleEn: In a much different spot than last season, Vlad Jr. talks about his struggles in '26
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Just over a year ago, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. stood in this same rugged hallway at Fenway Park. It was the beginning of the greatest year of his baseball life.

He’d just signed a $500 million contract that morning. He didn’t know it yet, but a World Series run was laid out in front of him, and in six months, he’d be the most popular man in the country. Saturday afternoon, he walked down that same hallway, between all of the brick and concrete, and last year suddenly felt so long ago.

We’re talking about endings now, not beginnings. The 47-57 Blue Jays are careening towards the Trade Deadline as sellers. Just as Guerrero’s brilliance defined the 2025 Blue Jays, his struggles define this year’s team.

Entering Saturday, Guerrero has just six home runs this season, tied for 223rd in baseball. Of the 147 qualified hitters, his .354 slugging percentage ranks Guerrero 132nd. Rays speedster Chandler Simpson, who’s never homered in the big leagues, sits one spot above him. Everywhere you look, this gets more stunning.

“There’s still 58 games left. I know I’m better than that and I know I can get better,” Guerrero said through interpreter Hector Lebron. “It’s frustrating. There’s 58 games left and you know how baseball is. Anything can happen. Myself and the rest of the guys, we’ve just got to continue to play hard.”

Guerrero asked fans to be patient, which is a tricky proposal. Blue Jays fans came into this season with World Series expectations, because of course they did. This season hasn’t just been a disappointment in the standings, it’s seen the Blue Jays lose the identity that made them a countrywide sensation in 2025. They’re dead last in MLB in runs scored. Unless you’re playing airtight defense with a few Cy Young candidates in the rotation, that’s never going to work.

The face of the franchise isn’t oblivious to this, of course. That $500 million contract signs you up for expectations and criticisms that others simply don’t face. We can debate where the line is on what’s “fair," but part of Guerrero’s job description is now to take on more media responsibilities, more pressure and more responsibility than everyone else in that clubhouse.

“He’s dealt with it forever, good or bad,” manager John Schneider said. “When he’s good, that’s what he’s supposed to do. When he’s not, it’s, ‘What the hell are you doing?’ He’s handling it well. It’s important for him to really show the way here when times are tough. He’s somebody who the guys look up to and follow. It’s a little extra for him. Him talking to you guys and saying he’s not playing as good as he can be and we’re not playing as good as we can be is accountability.”

There’s also a difference between public messaging and what happens when the clubhouse doors close. All of those times Schneider sits at the podium, holding steady for his team and preaching his belief in the next day? That’s just the version we see. Minutes later, he could be lighting up the clubhouse or sitting a player down in his office.

Schneider knows Guerrero as well as anyone, at least anyone without the last name “Guerrero." Beyond the 2025 World Series, he was right there for Guerrero’s best days as the No. 1 prospect in the game, standing on the top step of the dugout and watching on in awe. Schneider knows the incredible things Guerrero is capable of, but we haven’t seen them in too long.

“He’s trying to capture the same thing. When it’s right, he’s one of the best,” Schneider said. “He’s trying to get there and not reinvent himself at this point. It’s just being on time, hitting the ball hard and whatever happens is going to happen. It always comes down to what you’re swinging at. If he’s swinging in the zone, he’s pretty good.”

Guerrero isn’t the only reason the Blue Jays are in this spot, only one of dozens. If you look at that long list, though, Guerrero’s name stands out. It’s the most surprising story of the season, a season which is just over a week away from what could be a dark day at the Trade Deadline.
“I let the front office do their job,” Guerrero said. “I’m going to focus and concentrate on doing my job.”
That’s how he’s always wanted it. Guerrero’s job description changed in these Fenway hallways a year ago, though, and now, he’s seen both sides of what that brings.
items.titleZh: 与上赛季截然不同，小弗拉迪谈2026赛季挣扎
items.summaryZh: 小弗拉基米尔·格雷罗谈本赛季挣扎，蓝鸟队陷入困境。
bodyZh: 波士顿——就在一年多前，小弗拉基米尔·格雷罗站在芬威球场这条崎岖的走廊上。那是他棒球生涯最伟大一年的开始。
那天早上他刚签下一份5亿美元的合同。他还不知道，但一次世界大赛征程已摆在他面前，六个月后，他将成为这个国家最受欢迎的人。周六下午，他再次走过那条走廊，穿梭在砖石之间，去年突然感觉如此遥远。
现在我们谈论的是结局，而非开始。47胜57负的蓝鸟正作为卖家冲向交易截止日。正如格雷罗的辉煌定义了2025年的蓝鸟，他的挣扎定义了今年的球队。
截至周六，格雷罗本赛季仅打出6支本垒打，并列大联盟第223位。在147名符合资格的打者中，他的长打率.354排名第132位。光芒队快腿钱德勒·辛普森，这位从未在大联盟击出本垒打的球员，排名比他高一位。无论从哪个角度看，这都令人震惊。
“还有58场比赛。我知道我比这更好，我也知道我可以变得更好，”格雷罗通过翻译Hector Lebron表示，“这很令人沮丧。还有58场比赛，你知道棒球是什么样的。任何事情都可能发生。我和其他队友，我们只需要继续努力打球。”
格雷罗请求球迷保持耐心，这是一个棘手的提议。蓝鸟球迷带着世界大赛的期望进入本赛季，他们当然会这样。本赛季不仅在战绩上令人失望，蓝鸟还失去了让他们在2025年成为全国热点的身份。他们的得分在大联盟垫底。除非你拥有滴水不漏的防守和轮值中几位赛扬奖候选人，否则这永远行不通。
当然，球队的门面并非对此视而不见。那份5亿美元的合同带来了他人无需面对的期望和批评。我们可以争论“公平”的界限在哪里，但格雷罗的工作描述的一部分就是现在要承担比更衣室里其他人更多的媒体责任、更多的压力和更多的责任。
“他一直在处理这件事，无论好坏，”主教练John Schneider说，“当他表现好时，那是他该做的。当他表现不好时，就是‘你到底在搞什么？’他处理得很好。在困难时期，他真正起到带头作用很重要。他是队友们仰望和追随的人。这对他来说是额外的。他对你们媒体说他自己打得不够好，我们全队打得不够好，这是一种担当。”
公开信息与更衣室门关闭后发生的事情之间也存在差异。所有那些Schneider坐在讲台上，为球队保持镇定并宣扬他对明天的信念的时刻？那只是我们看到的版本。几分钟后，他可能会在更衣室里发火，或者叫球员到办公室谈话。
Schneider比任何人都了解格雷罗，至少比任何不姓“格雷罗”的人都了解。除了2025年世界大赛，他还见证了格雷罗作为头号新秀的最佳时光，站在休息区最高台阶上敬畏地观看。Schneider知道格雷罗能够做到多么不可思议的事情，但我们太久没有看到了。
“他在努力重现同样的东西。当一切都对了，他是最好的之一，”Schneider说，“他正在努力达到那个状态，而不是现在重新改造自己。只是要准时到位，用力击球，然后顺其自然。一切都归结于你在挥击什么球。如果他在好球带内挥棒，他就很出色。”
蓝鸟陷入这种境地，格雷罗不是唯一原因，只是众多原因之一。然而，如果你看看那长长的名单，格雷罗的名字格外突出。这是本赛季最令人惊讶的故事，而距离可能成为交易截止日黑暗日的时间只剩一周多。
“我让管理层做他们的工作，”格雷罗说，“我会专注并集中精力做好我的工作。”
他一直希望如此。然而，一年前在芬威的走廊里，格雷罗的工作描述发生了变化，而现在，他看到了这带来的两面。

items.titleEn: Yesavage battles in 9-K start as Wild Card gap widens ahead of Deadline
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Even when the Blue Jays find a way to make a game of it, the American League Wild Card race just keeps drifting away from them.
Friday night’s 6-4 loss to the Red Sox at Fenway Park dropped the Blue Jays (47-57) to 6 1/2 games back of the final Wild Card spot with the Aug. 3 Trade Deadline looming.
This is what mattered most:
1. Okamoto can’t do it all himself

Kazuma Okamoto breathed some life back into this game with a three-run shot in the seventh, which broke Shohei Ohtani’s 2018 record for home runs by a Japanese-born rookie with 23. Without any help, though, that lives on as a footnote in another loss.

This could have been the go-ahead blast, but the Blue Jays let Patrick Sandoval off the hook in the first inning and handed the Red Sox a zero on the scoreboard. Toronto loaded the bases, even watching Sandoval throw 10 straight balls at one point, but Davis Schneider looked at strike three to end the threat.

“The first inning, this team’s about as hot as you can get, right?” manager John Schneider said. “And they’re coming off an off-day, so you want to take advantage of anything you can early. We had traffic, but we left a lot of guys on and had some pitches to hit that we didn’t capitalize on. I love the way they battled back, a big at-bat from Okamoto and then getting one in the eighth, but early on, we probably could have done a bit more.”

The Blue Jays’ numbers with the bases loaded this season aren’t pretty. They’ve actually run into the odd burst of power with three grand slams over their 57 at-bats, but oddly enough, their contact ability hasn’t shown up. The Blue Jays rank second-last in baseball with a .193 average in these situations, better than only the Marlins (.173).

Let’s not pretend that 57 at-bats are enough of a sample size to draw major conclusions from, but this is yet another layer to why the offense has struggled. Big hits in big moments have been lacking, and were again on Friday.
2. We saw every version of Yesavage
At some points, Trey Yesavage looked like the rookie who lit MLB on fire last season. Even after the long, shaky first frame, he came right back and struck out the side in the second.

Yesavage’s pitch count ran up quickly, though, a product of a whopping nine strikeouts over just four innings -- which the Blue Jays will happily take -- but also the long at-bats that got him there. Even in that second inning with three strikeouts, Yesavage had a couple of eight-pitch battles. Turning some of those into a four-pitch strikeout, or even a weak ground ball on the second pitch he throws, is the key to unlocking the rest of his potential.
“I was getting ahead early. I think every batter I faced, I got to a two-strike count,” Yesavage said. “It’s just a matter of putting them away, which really drove up the pitch count.”

If everything already points to 2027 and beyond at this point, which it very well might, Yesavage’s growth is one of the most important factors in this organization. He owns a 3.92 ERA over 85 innings, on pace to land somewhere in the range of 150 this season. That would be a great baseline heading into ‘27, but the efficiency from start to start remains crucial.
“We just need to come together, win ballgames and play for each other,” Yesavage said.
3. Could the Red Sox be a trade partner?

For now, the Blue Jays are chasing the Red Sox and Guardians, who are in a tight race holding the second and third Wild Card spots. Between the Blue Jays and those teams are the Mariners, Twins, Astros, Orioles and Tigers, so there’s nothing simple about this. Toronto’s postseason odds are shrinking by the day.

These two teams could soon line up as trade partners, which has happened before. When the Blue Jays were out of the race in 2024, they traded Danny Jansen to Boston for prospects Cutter Coffey (Toronto’s No. 22 prospect per MLB Pipeline), Eddinson Paulino and Gilberto Bautista. In 2018, the Blue Jays traded Steve Pearce to the Red Sox, who went on to be the World Series MVP.
If George Springer is dealt -- which looks likely at this point -- it’s easy to see a potential fit with the Red Sox as a veteran DH type and part-time outfielder.
items.titleZh: 耶萨维奇9K再战，外卡差距在交易截止日前扩大
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟6-4负红袜，外卡落后6.5场；冈本和真破纪录本垒打难救主。
bodyZh: 波士顿——即使蓝鸟能让比赛有悬念，美国联盟外卡争夺却离他们越来越远。
周五晚上在芬威公园以6-4输给红袜后，蓝鸟（47胜57负）在交易截止日（8月3日）前夕，距离最后一个外卡席位落后6.5场。
以下是本场比赛最关键的几点：
1. 冈本和真无法独自扛起球队
冈本和真在第七局轰出三分本垒打，以23支本垒打打破了大谷翔平2018年创下的日本出生新秀本垒打纪录，为比赛注入了一些活力。然而，没有其他帮助，这只能成为又一场失利的注脚。
这本可能是反超的一击，但蓝鸟在首局让Patrick Sandoval轻松脱身，让红袜在记分板上挂零。多伦多一度满垒，甚至看到Sandoval连续投出10个坏球，但Davis Schneider目送第三球被三振，化解了威胁。
“第一局，这支球队状态火热，对吧？”主教练John Schneider说。“而且他们刚休息了一天，所以你想尽早利用任何机会。我们有人上垒，但留下很多跑者，有些好球没把握住。我喜欢他们反击的方式，冈本的关键打席和第八局得分，但早期我们本可以做得更多。”
蓝鸟本赛季在满垒时的数据并不好看。实际上他们有过三次满贯本垒打，在57个打数中偶尔爆发火力，但奇怪的是，他们的击球能力并没有显现。蓝鸟在满垒时的打击率为.193，排名联盟倒数第二，仅好于马林鱼（.173）。
我们别假装57个打数是足够得出重大结论的样本量，但这只是进攻挣扎的又一个层面。关键时刻的安打一直缺乏，周五也不例外。
2. 我们看到了耶萨维奇的各种版本
在某些时刻，Trey Yesavage看起来像上赛季点燃大联盟的新秀。即使在漫长的、不稳定的第一局之后，他立刻回稳，在第二局三振了对手侧。
然而，Yesavage的用球数迅速上升，这是他在仅仅四局内送出九次三振的代价——蓝鸟对此会欣然接受——但也因为那些漫长的打席。即使在第二局的三次三振中，Yesavage也有几次八球对决。如果能将其中一些变成四球三振，或者第二个投球就制造弱滚地球，是释放他其余潜力的关键。
“我早早取得球数领先。我想我面对每个打者都取得了两好球，”Yesavage说。“只是解决他们的问题，这确实推高了用球数。”
如果在这一点上一切都指向2027年及以后，很可能确实如此，那么Yesavage的成长是这支球队最重要的因素之一。他在85局中自责分率为3.92，本赛季有望投到150局左右。这将是进入27年的良好基准，但从一场先发到下一场的效率仍然至关重要。
“我们只需要团结起来，赢得比赛，为彼此而战，”Yesavage说。
3. 红袜可能成为交易伙伴？
目前，蓝鸟正在追赶红袜和守护者，这两队正激烈争夺第二和第三外卡席位。在蓝鸟和这些球队之间还有水手、双城、太空人、金莺和老虎，所以没有任何简单办法。多伦多的季后赛概率日益缩小。
这两支球队很快可能成为交易伙伴，这以前发生过。2024年蓝鸟退出竞争时，他们将Danny Jansen交易到波士顿，换来潜力新秀Cutter Coffey（MLB Pipeline蓝鸟第22号新秀）、Eddinson Paulino和Gilberto Bautista。2018年，蓝鸟将Steve Pearce交易到红袜，后者随后成为世界大赛MVP。
如果George Springer被交易——现在看来很有可能——很容易看到他与红袜的潜在契合，作为一名资深指定打击型和兼职外野手。
items.author: Keegan Matheson

items.titleEn: Ohtani held this record until last night -- but not anymore, thanks to Okamoto
bodyEn: BOSTON -- With one big swing on Friday night at Fenway Park, Kazuma Okamoto broke Shohei Ohtani’s rookie record for the most home runs by a Japanese-born player, with 23.

The Statcast-projected 408-foot shot to straightaway center finally got the Blue Jays on the board in the seventh inning in an eventual 6-4 loss to the Red Sox. In a quiet season for the lowest-scoring offense in Major League Baseball, Okamoto has been one of the lone bright spots.
“That’s pretty cool that he sets the Japanese rookie record for homers in a season. That’s a great accomplishment for him, and I told him that,” manager John Schneider said. “He’s so talented.”

Any day your name lands in the same sentence as Ohtani’s is a good one, and even though Okamoto has downplayed any milestone, his respect for his fellow Japanese star is clear. The two have also played together in the World Baseball Classic, representing their country.

“It’s just a number,” Okamoto said through interpreter Yusuke Oshima when he tied the record just prior to the All-Star break. “As you all know, Shohei is an awesome player. He’s a unicorn. To be able to match that record is obviously awesome. I want to do my best so that I can get closer to his level.”

That hadn’t changed by Friday night, either. As we all get to know Okamoto -- from fans to media and teammates -- it’s immediately clear that he’s a team-first player. He’ll deflect the conversation back to his teammates and the team’s success any time he can. Anything to take the attention off himself and his own accomplishments, no matter how impressive they are.
“There’s nothing in particular [I care about] on the personal side,” Okamoto said. “Just getting the ‘W.’ That’s the only category I’m looking at.”

Okamoto doesn’t hit cheap ones, either. There are no wall-scrapers and no batted-ball luck in this new Japanese rookie record, and while Okamoto has certainly struggled with strikeouts at times, his power has been undeniable. The Blue Jays’ offense has been searching for answers anywhere and everywhere, but power has been one of this group’s biggest shortcomings, making Okamoto’s presence all the more important.

In a lineup still searching for its identity, and still searching for a pulse as they fade in the AL Wild Card race, there are parts of Okamoto’s offensive game that Schneider would love to see spread to the rest of the lineup.

Besides, Okamoto is running away with the team lead in home runs, his 23 more than double his next-closest teammate (George Springer, 10). It’s the same story when it comes to RBIs, too, with Okamoto’s 65 towering above his teammates (Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is second with 42).

“When he’s good, he swings with intent and hunts certain areas,” Schneider said. “He’s unique because he has power to all fields. Today to dead center is an example of that. He’s not being afraid to let it rip and let it go, and be ready for certain pitches in certain areas. He’s done a really good job of that this year.”

Still in the first year of his four-year, $60 million deal, Okamoto was one of the Blue Jays’ best moves this past offseason and has handled the move to Major League Baseball admirably. The record is all his for now, but this race isn’t over.
Munetaka Murakami of the White Sox has hit 20 in fewer games after spending some time on the IL, and he has remarkable power to match Okamoto’s if this turns into a race down the stretch.
items.titleZh: Okamoto打破Ohtani保持的日本球员新秀本垒打纪录
items.summaryZh: Okamoto以23支本垒打打破Ohtani保持的日本球员新秀本垒打纪录
bodyZh: 波士顿——周五晚在芬威球场，Kazuma Okamoto一记大力挥棒，以23支本垒打打破了大谷翔平（Shohei Ohtani）保持的日本出生球员新秀本垒打纪录。
Statcast预测的408英尺直飞中外野的本垒打，让蓝鸟在第七局终于得分，最终以4-6输给红袜。对于大联盟得分最低的进攻组来说，这是一个沉寂的赛季，Okamoto是少数亮点之一。
“他创造了日本球员单季本垒打新秀纪录，这很酷。这对他是项了不起的成就，我告诉他了，”主教练John Schneider说道。“他非常有天赋。”
任何一天你的名字和大谷翔平出现在同一句话里都是好事，尽管Okamoto对任何里程碑都轻描淡写，但他对这位日本同胞的敬意是显而易见的。两人还曾在世界棒球经典赛中一起为国效力。
“这只是一个数字，”Okamoto在明星赛前追平纪录时通过翻译Yusuke Oshima说道。“大家都知道，大谷是一位了不起的球员。他是独角兽。能够追平这个纪录显然很棒。我想尽最大努力接近他的水平。”
到了周五晚，这一点也没有改变。随着我们对Okamoto的了解——从球迷、媒体到队友——可以立刻看出他是团队至上的球员。只要有机会，他就会把话题引回队友和球队的成功上。任何能转移对自己和自己成就关注的事情，无论它们多么令人印象深刻。
“个人方面我没什么特别在意的，”Okamoto说道。“只在乎赢球。这是我看重的唯一类别。”
Okamoto的本垒打也不廉价。这个新的日本新秀纪录中没有擦墙而过的本垒打，也没有击球运气，尽管Okamoto有时确实被三振困扰，但他的力量是无可否认的。蓝鸟的进攻一直在到处寻找答案，但力量是这支球队最大的短板之一，这使得Okamoto的存在更加重要。
在一套仍在寻找身份、随着在美联外卡竞争中逐渐掉队而仍在寻找活力的打线中，Schneider希望Okamoto进攻端的某些部分能延伸到整条打线。
此外，Okamoto在本垒打上遥遥领先全队，他的23支是第二名队友（George Springer，10支）的两倍多。打点方面也是如此，Okamoto的65分打点远远超过队友（Vladimir Guerrero Jr.以42分排名第二）。
“当他状态好时，他会带着意图挥棒，并瞄准特定区域，”Schneider说道。“他独一无二，因为他对所有方向都有力量。今天打向中外野深处就是一个例子。他不害怕全力挥棒并放手一搏，并准备好应对特定区域的特定球种。今年他在这方面做得非常好。”
仍处于4年6000万美元合同第一年的Okamoto，是蓝鸟上个休赛季的最佳操作之一，并且出色地适应了大联盟。纪录现在完全属于他，但这场竞争尚未结束。
白袜的Munetaka Murakami在伤病名单上待了一段时间后，在更少的比赛中打出了20支，如果他俩在赛季末段展开竞争，他拥有与Okamoto匹敌的非凡力量。

items.titleEn: Barger set for season-ending elbow surgery to cap injury-filled campaign
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Blue Jays outfielder Addison Barger's long, frustrating season is now a lost season. Barger will undergo right elbow surgery on Monday, which could require a full Tommy John procedure.

If that’s the case, Barger’s rehab process is estimated around nine months, which would stretch well into the 2027 season. If he only needs an internal brace procedure in that elbow, it could be closer to six months.

Barger has been dealing with elbow issues for “a couple of years," manager John Schneider said Friday, but he aggravated this in May, when he uncorked a 101.2-mph throw from right field to get the tagging runner at home and end the inning. It was the hardest-tracked throw on an outfield assist in Barger’s career and the hardest of any Blue Jays player in the Statcast era (since 2015). Unfortunately, that’s come back to bite him.

Barger’s season is now officially over, his 2026 stat line reading just 1-for-22 (.045) over nine games played. First, it was a left ankle injury, then his right elbow and later his back, which developed a stress fracture. This has felt like a cursed season for the 26-year-old, who was coming off a fantastic performance in the 2025 World Series and expected to be a major contributor in ‘26.

“It’s tough to lose the whole year of at-bats, reps and performance,” Schneider said. “We were counting on him to be a big part of our team. You can see how much we miss him, for sure. It’s also a dude starting his career and trending in the right direction who’s missing, basically, a full season. It’s frustrating for him and for us.”

Ninety-nine percent of the time, when you hear “Tommy John” and “internal brace," we’re talking about a pitcher. Barger’s surgery and rehab will be unique, but if this required the full-blown procedure, there are some recent examples to work with.

Bryce Harper underwent Tommy John surgery in November 2022, and he returned to the Phillies’ lineup just 160 days later on May 2, 2023. That was as a DH, though, and Harper didn’t play the field again as a first baseman until July 21 of that season. Those are both a long way from playing right field and throwing the way Barger likes to throw, which is max effort at all times.

If Barger’s bat was undeniable and simply needed to be in the Blue Jays’ lineup, this could be an option in early 2027, but that still feels very unlikely and something only reserved for the elite tier of hitters.

Corey Seager might be a more useful case here. At the end of April 2018, Seager hit the IL and underwent Tommy John surgery soon after. He returned for Opening Day 2019, which was essentially an 11-month rehab process. Seager returned as a shortstop, too, so this works as an example of a player returning to full, regular game reps which included throwing.

The first step for Barger will come when Dr. Keith Meister performs the procedure on Monday, and a decision is made between Tommy John or the internal brace procedure. From there, it will be several months until we can get a fee for Barger’s timeline, regardless of which path this goes down.

This finally brings some clarity to Barger’s season, but that’s no consolation. In a season defined by injuries and a lack of production from core players, Barger’s frustrating 2026 campaign has unfortunately come to represent just that.
items.titleZh: Barger将接受赛季末肘部手术，结束伤病缠身的赛季
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟外野手Bagger因右肘手术赛季报销，可能需Tommy John手术，恢复期约9个月。
bodyZh: 波士顿——蓝鸟队外野手Addison Barger漫长而令人沮丧的赛季如今彻底报销。Barger将于周一接受右肘手术，可能需要完整的Tommy John手术。
如果是这样，Barger的康复过程预计约9个月，将延续到2027赛季。如果他的肘部只需要内部支撑手术，则可能接近6个月。
主教练John Schneider周五表示，Barger的肘部问题已经持续“几年”，但他在5月加重了伤势——当时他从右外野送出一记101.2英里/小时的传球，触杀本垒跑垒员结束半局。这是Barger职业生涯中外野助攻略最强的一记传球，也是Statcast时代（自2015年）以来蓝鸟球员中最强的。不幸的是，这反而对他造成了伤害。
Barger的赛季现已正式结束，他2026年的统计数据仅为9场比赛22打数1安打（打击率.045）。先是左脚踝受伤，然后是右肘，再后来是背部应力性骨折。对于这位26岁的球员来说，这感觉像是一个被诅咒的赛季——他刚在2025年世界大赛中表现出色，本被期望在2026年成为主要贡献者。
“失去一整年的打席、出场次数和表现是很难受的，”Schneider说，“我们曾指望他成为球队的重要部分。你可以看到我们有多么想念他。而且这是一个职业生涯刚刚起步、正朝正确方向前进的球员，却缺席了几乎整个赛季。这让他和我们都很沮丧。”
99%的情况下，当你听到“Tommy John”和“内部支撑”时，我们谈论的是投手。Barger的手术和康复将是独特的，但如果需要完整的手术，可以参考一些近期的例子。
Bryce Harper在2022年11月接受了Tommy John手术，仅160天后，他于2023年5月2日重返费城人队阵容。不过那是作为指定打击，Harper直到同年7月21日才再次担任一垒手守备。而守右外野并以Barger喜欢的方式（始终全力）传球，与这些都有很大距离。
如果Barger的打击实力无可争议，并且蓝鸟队阵容中确实需要他，那么2027年初复出可能是一个选择，但这仍然感觉非常不可能，而且只适用于顶尖打者。
Corey Seager可能是一个更有用的案例。2018年4月底，Seager进入伤病名单，不久后接受了Tommy John手术。他在2019年开幕日回归，这基本上是11个月的康复过程。Seager回归后仍担任游击手，因此这可以作为球员回归完整常规比赛（包括传球）的例子。
Barger的第一步将在周一由Dr. Keith Meister实施手术时进行，并在Tommy John手术或内部支撑手术之间做出决定。之后，无论选择哪条路，都需要几个月才能了解Barger的时间表。
这终于为Barger的赛季带来了一些明确性，但这并非安慰。在一个以伤病和核心球员产出不足为特点的赛季中，Barger令人沮丧的2026赛季不幸地恰恰代表了这一点。
